subject.title: [Bug]: Feishu DM sessions rebuilt after gateway restart — duplicate keys + maintenance pruning

question: Which Feishu DM identity and retention repair should OpenClaw adopt for multi-account direct-message sessions, and how should existing unscoped or malformed rows be repaired?
rationale: The source proves current behavior is only mitigated, but the durable session-key, malformed-id validation, and direct-DM retention choices can affect existing user history and store growth.

options.title: Feishu-Owned Identity Plus Doctor Repair
options.body: Prefer account-scoped Feishu DM identity for multi-account setups, add Feishu-boundary malformed-id detection or repair, and migrate existing affected rows through doctor before runtime assumes the canonical shape.

options.title: Retention Policy First
options.body: Choose a TTL-aware direct-message maintenance policy first and leave Feishu malformed-id and account-scoping changes for a follow-up identity design.

options.title: Document Workaround Only
options.body: Keep `per-account-channel-peer` as the supported workaround and close only after maintainers explicitly accept no code repair for existing Feishu DM stores.

recommendation.title: Feishu-Owned Identity Plus Doctor Repair
recommendation.body: Prefer account-scoped Feishu DM identity for multi-account setups, add Feishu-boundary malformed-id detection or repair, and migrate existing affected rows through doctor before runtime assumes the canonical shape.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is Feishu-specific identity behavior plus plugin-owned validation, even though core session maintenance also needs review.
